topography.project_purpose: Universe XYZ is a yield protocol on Ethereum that enables users to stake tokens and earn rewards through a set of staking and liquidity pool contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: The IlluviumERC20 token is used within the Staking contract for reward distribution, while the UniswapV2Pair provides liquidity for the token. Supporting contracts like BarnBridgeToken and Comp may serve as external reward tokens or governance interfaces.
